type: the expected_uninformative whitelist, which turned into three noise-bug fixes in the audit itself

three_bugs_found_in_my_own_tool.constant_on_eval_noise: fired for every level absent from the evaluation sample, which in a 65-drug one-hot design is most columns
three_bugs_found_in_my_own_tool.unseen_codes_on_indicators: fired on indicator columns where absence is pure sampling
three_bugs_found_in_my_own_tool.partial_masking_slipped_through: a column masked to -1 on some rows and 0 on others is neither constant nor an unseen code, and that is exactly the R138 shape; a new SENTINEL_OUTSIDE_VOCAB check now catches it

the_whitelist.scope: feature-level flags only, on named columns only
the_whitelist.cannot_suppress: prediction-level and split-level alarms, since neither can be intentional
the_whitelist.danger_demonstrated: the same masked design that is correctly flagged passes once its columns are declared expected
the_whitelist.recommendation: never whitelist a block whose purpose is to SIMULATE an unavailable feature; whitelist only blocks unavailable by construction

reinterprets_R157: the all-four-arms flag there was mostly the CONSTANT_ON_EVAL noise, not a design defect; under the corrected rules the R157 design passes cleanly
remaining_blind_spot: sentinel values on continuous columns, such as -999, are still missed
